notes.title: GOOD LUCK BABY!, Noodletub's new yuri visual novel, now LIVE on KICKSTARTER!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, and thank you so much for playing THE GHOST OF YOU! We truly appreciate all of the love and support we've received since the game's release, and we truly hope that everyone has enjoyed their time with our eclectic cast of girls. 

[b][h1][url=https://kickstarter.com/projects/noodletub/good-luck-baby-a-yuri-visual-novel]We're posting an update today to announce our third big yuri project: GOOD LUCK BABY![/url][/h1][/b]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/noodletub/good-luck-baby-a-yuri-visual-novel][img]https://i.imgur.com/OaVv2cx.png[/img][/url]

The story revolves around our two leading girls – Hifumi Tanaka and Kasumi Itou – unravelling the mysteries behind the sudden appearance of a baby with wings, a halo, and strange powers on their doorstep. The mystery runs deeper than they could ever imagine, with the fate of the world itself resting in this tiny baby's hands. What is their role in this path fate has sent them down, and just who is the ruthless villain trying to snatch the baby away at any cost?

Much like our other projects, GOOD LUCK BABY! Is a yuri visual novel that includes mystery, drama, and girls falling in love amidst an unbelievable situation. If funding proves to be extra successful, it will launch with three fully realized routes – each of which features a focus on different characters, an original story, and tons of yuri! This is a story we here at Noodletub have been working on for a long time now, and we're so happy to finally unveil it to the world. 

But it needs your help! Without the generous pledges of Kickstarter backers, we won't be able to fund the project. All Kickstarter backers who pledge to get a copy of GOOD LUCK BABY! Will receive it at a sweet discount, as it will launch on Steam and itch.io at a higher price once released. If funded, the game will launch on Steam and itch.io for PC.

[h1][url=https://kickstarter.com/projects/noodletub/good-luck-baby-a-yuri-visual-novel]Check out the Kickstarter page for more information, and help us bring this project to life. Thank you so much for the support![/url][/h1]

notes.title: Our newest game, LOVE BAKUDAN, has been released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Thank you so much for playing and enjoying The Ghost of You these past few years. It was in part thanks to the warm reception to our first title that spurred us on to make our second one, which is now out and available to play; LOVE BAKUDAN!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34044558/c155176fe9a2ca6e4712f2a668f070937e290055.png[/img]

LOVE BAKUDAN is an 18+ yuri visual novel about Haruka Mishima, a young woman who inherits an erotic bookstore - and all of the drama, romance and daily life that comes with it. With six unique romance routes, erotic books to read for yourself and a special extra route, who will be the love bomb of your choice?

For those of you who enjoyed The Ghost of You, this may be a departure in terms of the game's tone, but not in terms of what the game has to offer. LOVE BAKUDAN features an all female cast, a female protagonist, and every unlockable book in the game centers around girls in love.

The game is also significantly longer than TGOY overall, with a staggering 640,000+ wordcount! It was a real labour of love, and we hope you feel the passion we hold for this world and its characters throughout every moment of the game.

The game is currently available for purchase [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1511040/LOVE_BAKUDAN/]on Steam[/url] as well [url=https://noodletub.itch.io/love-bakudan]as itch.io.[/url] 

Thank you so much for your support over the years, and we sincerely hope you enjoy LOVE BAKUDAN!

notes.title: Kickstarter for our new 18+ yuri game, LOVE BAKUDAN, is now live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, long time no see! First of all, a big thanks for buying and enjoying The Ghost of You over the past year. We read all reviews and social media mentions, and we have been so flattered and grateful for all of the kindness and encouragement we have received. Thank you! 

The reason we're here today is very exciting! Noodletub has been toiling away on a new and exciting project, and we can finally show it off to the world: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/noodletub/love-bakudan-an-18-yuri-visual-novel]LOVE BAKUDAN[/url]! From the very same team that brought you The Ghost of You, this is definitely a departure, but one we think you'll like.

LOVE BAKUDAN is set to be an 18+ comedy/drama yuri visual novel. Our protagonist, Haruka Mishima, inherits an erotic bookstore from her dearly departed (and very cheeky) grandma. But you don’t just sell these risque books… you can read them all, too!

Currently set to launch with three fully illustrated adult romance routes, LOVE BAKUDAN is going to be an EXPLOSIVE time - but this time, we can’t do it without you. If you’re interested, [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/noodletub/love-bakudan-an-18-yuri-visual-novel]please take a look at our list of Kickstarter rewards and see which one suits you best[/url]; every contribution helps. Thank you, and let’s light the fuse of this yuri adventure together! 💣

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/noodletub/love-bakudan-an-18-yuri-visual-novel]Check out the Kickstarter HERE![/url] Thanks so much for your interest, and we hope to see you on the doorstep of Bakudan Books!

notes.title: The best horror games for non-horror fans
notes.content:
It’s Halloween! We’ve put the Hivemind Of Horror into a spooky jar of bubbling green liquid, and it’ll be pumping horror-themed articles onto the site today.

Do you struggle with horror games? Me too. I could list exceptions. System Shock 2, or the good Aliens Vs Predator (even after months of playing it, getting caught by a facehugger always sccared the bejesus out of me). Even Resident Evil 2, cheesy and sometimes predictable as it was. But those are the obvious ones. You’ve already played those.

So I’ve been looking back at the last few years, and you know what? There have been some bloody great horror games that aren’t, you know, the bad kind of horror, and I think it’s about time they got their due. Here then, are my Halloween recommendations for people who aren’t really into most horror games.

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: The Last Gasp of 2018
notes.content:
We’re back! Did you have a good Christmas break? Get into that backlog, did you?

Yeah, me neither. Not to worry! Due to the awkward way the games industry and linear time interact, this week’s selection is technically of 2018 vintage, so you’re allowed to try them all without any anxiety or apologies to the other 73 unplayed games you’ll totally get round to sometime soon, maybe next week. It’s time to read about the very best stragglers among the many, many indie games released on Steam over the holidays. It’s Unknown Pleasures.

Still writing the wrong year on forms this week: bureaucratic backstabbing, arcade throwbacks, and queer horror. Quorror. (more…)
